name: Dev Creature QURUGOSK
description: Purchase to unlock Qurugosk, AlertcoderF's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Land Qurugosk is a dev creature representing Alertcoderf. These creatures bear deadly sharp claws and a natural glowing fire eminating from their ghastly body. These creatures are extremely fast and defend well from bleed, though lighter and slightly weaker than other similar tiers.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ANI
description: Purchase to unlock the Ani species, playable in-game! Tier: 1 (Tiny) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Land Ani are quite unusual creatures, they roam Sonaria mostly as solitary travelers, constantly in search of the injured. It is known that they have a deep sense of altruism and that these mysterious creatures can harness powers from the closest star to heal those in need.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature TRUTHOLBYEVA
description: Purchase to unlock the Trutholbyeva species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Flier Trutholbyeva, a fiercely aggressive nocturnal herbivore, typically lives alone or in small groups. Emerging from caves at night to feed on bushes, it retreats to dark places during the day. Its back teeth are used for chewing, while front teeth are adapted for ramming into enemies.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature GHIBLI
description: Purchase to unlock the Ghibli species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier This creature inhabits the desert skies, relying on its large wings and winged tail for swift maneuvers. It ambushes prey from above, seizing them with four front arms before delivering a fatal drop.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Dev Creature NYCTOXON
description: Purchase to unlock the Nyctoxon, JaxonBirb's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Land Emerging from a frost so powerful and cold, Nyctoxon can manipulate ice through psychic energy, manifesting all of its power through its central eye. They are capable of creating many objects to assist them in battle, even massive icicle weapons. Those unlucky enough to be caught in its icy traps meet a terrible fate.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature URA
description: Purchase to unlock the Ura species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Omnivore Terrain: Flier The Ura live in solitude and are fairly docile. Their hunting grounds are primarily oceans as they traverse the sea and skies with equal agility. It is rare to find them on land as the Ura are always moving and require little sleep, and lack in speed on foot.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature AHRI'TAHMUK
description: Purchase to unlock the Ahri'Tahmuk species, playable in-game! Tier: 5 (Huge) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Ahri'Tahmuk’s, an ancient reptilian creature from beyond Sonaria’s atmosphere, 3 heads and large shadow strike fear into Sonaria’s residents, a warning to stay far away.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Dev Creature ARCHALIUM
description: Purchase to unlock Archalium, Erythia's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Archalium are vicious creatures that cut through the skies at high speeds. Their aerial grace leaves its prey confused and mesmerized before suddenly being attacked. Archalium are also very territorial and protect their young with their lives.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Dev Creature TOHUKOS
description: Purchase to unlock Tohukos, Stood_04's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Omnivore Terrain: Land Tohukos is an extremely swift and agile creature that can be seen running among the forests and rocky regions of Sonaria. They tend to prefer plants over meat, but won’t hesitate to use its speed to chase down small creatures for food when desperate. They are very energetic and social, having large varieties of groups scattered around Sonaria.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature OPRALEGION
description: Purchase to unlock the Opralegion species, playable in-game! Tier: 5 (Huge) Diet: Omnivore Terrain: Flier Majestic and otherworldy, Opralegion have a very caring personality and tend to watch over smaller creatures. When being observed, creatures will mistakenly attack them as they have a habit to hover over creatures they are curious about; Which makes them feel hostile and predatory.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature Rukig
description: Purchase to unlock the Rukig species, playable in-game! Tier: 1 (Tiny) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Land Rukig is a small scavenger that relies on its sticky fur to deter predators. Larger creatures usually avoid attacking Rukigs as prey and find them unpleasant. They are very energetic and like sticking in groups.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ZOOCUU
description: Purchase to unlock the Zoocuu species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Glider Zoocuu is a swift gliding creature that almost appears synthetic. It is filled with a golden substance that it can shoot out when threatened. They tend to be friendly in nature and avoid large creatures.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ADHARCAIIN
description: Purchase to unlock the Adharcaiin species, playable in-game! Tier: 2 (Small) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Semi-Aquatic Adharcaiin is a deadly water-dwelling predator that is not shy to hunt for sport. They are reclusive and elusive, living among the bottom of kelp forests waiting to drag down and drown its victims.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature FLEURALIS
description: Purchase to unlock the Fleuralis species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Omnivore Terrain: Land A stitched together looking mostly-feline with a few hints at a more reptilian lifestyle. Both parts cat and reptile seem to enjoy long hours basking and soaking up sunlight. Though Fleauralis are primarily docile, feeding on mostly gourds and berries, they will scavenge for carrion when food is bare.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature BANISHII
description: Purchase to unlock the Banishii species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Clever desert dwellers akin to Bazelii, with a queen system. Diurnal and fond of shiny accessories, especially reflective ones. Their queen resides in a castle adorned with mirrors to amplify light. Known for their speed and ability to inflict significant damage.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature BAZELII
description: Purchase to unlock the Bazelii species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Bazelii are nocturnal predators that lives in rocky cliffs and caves. These species are highly intelligent, able to forge weapons and accessories. They are ruled by an ancient queen, who lives in an icey mountain range under the stars. This species tends to be more brute-like and stronger compared to their counterparts, but sacrifice speed for strength.

name: Creature ANUTILL
description: Purchase to unlock the Anutill species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Despite their regal appearance, Anutill are natural tricksters. Collecting hoards of shiny objects and thriving off of smaller creatures, their quick speed puts them one step ahead.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Dev Creature DOWATT
description: Purchase to unlock Dowatt, Latedownload's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 2 (Small) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Glider Dowatt, small artificial beings from a distant planet, are tasked with surveillance and environmental analysis in the Orb. Composed of synthetic muscles, intricate computers, and electric circuits, they possess a defensive mechanism of high-voltage wires against predators.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Dev Creature LUCENSIA
description: Purchase to unlock Lucensia, BlckBrryJam's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 5 (Huge) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Lucensia are usually peaceful creatures, but will not hesitate to start a fight if a pack member is attacked. They enjoy warmer climates and will often be seen basking in the sun, creating shade with their massive wings.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ALTULIS
description: Purchase to unlock the Altulis species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Flier The Altulis are gentle, wise beasts with a taste for stargazing. Be wary, as their central star holds a frighteningly immense force.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ARKMETTA
description: Purchase to unlock the Arkmetta species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Land Toxic, fungi-like insects leaving trails of inky tar in dark environments. They litter their territory with sickly tar to trap unsuspecting creatures. Victims remain trapped until consumed by the Arkmetta.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Dev Creature HALLUCINIX
description: Purchase to unlock Hallucinix, Cinnakxll's developer species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier Originating from an ethereal limbo it inhabits, this thief of souls stalks its prey across multiple worlds. Possessing an unsettling gaze, creatures who look into its central eye for too long are known to have been driven mad. Encountering a Hallucinix is a dance with despair.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature SCRIMPEII
description: Purchase to unlock the Scrimpeii species, playable in-game! Tier: 2 (Small) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Aquatic Emerging from the shimmering oceanic trenches in the thousands when the tide turns, Scrimpeii are known for their grace and patterned beauty. At night their eyes glow, sometimes mirroring complex bioluminescent patterns above onto the dark ocean's surface, believed by some to be a sign of good luck.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature Gwiodama
description: Purchase to unlock the Gwiodama species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Land An incredibly lazy beast, Gwiodama are often found sleeping. This creature possesses a huge fang-lined maw that it uses to immediately swallow creatures in a single chomp, as it cannot be bothered to put in the effort to outlast its preys stamina in a chase. Once it has eaten it will remain still, and possibly fall asleep again for weeks on end.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature GOBBATLIN
description: Purchase to unlock the Gobbatlin species, playable in-game! Tier: 3 (Medium) Diet: Carnivore Terrain: Flier A skull mimic, this creatures' true form hides beneath the bone mask it has adorned. Soaring through the night skies under the full moon, the faint lunar light highlights their hypnotic membrane patterns. The faintest footstep of any prey is detected by this species using an advanced form of echolocation. Emitting a high frequency screech to locate its food oftentimes rattles the skull it wears, causing tiny fractures in the bone.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ASTOLO
description: Purchase to unlock the Astolo species, playable in-game! Tier: 2 (Small) Diet: Photovore Terrain: Flier The Astolo is a gentle guardian of nature. Known to take samples and carry rare species of flora many miles within their armored bodies, these creatures function as a failsafe for floral extinction. They collect the rarest of plants and store them within their lush-home caves, usually covered in ferns and ancient species of flowers. Rarely, a deactivated Astolo may be found, using the last of its energy to maintain the climate within its chest cavity, where an exotic plant resides.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature ULDRAAKÉ
description: Purchase to unlock the Uldraaké species, playable in-game! Tier: 4 (Large) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Land A great wyrm of pale blue scales, their immense weight carved valleys and fjords as they travelled the ice. When Uldraaké stirred, frozen plains buckled, mountains split, and glaciers advanced. Wraithful and destructive in nature, this being is shaped from the harshest of winters.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature SERAPHIS
description: Purchase to unlock the Seraphis species, playable in-game! Tier: 5 (Huge) Diet: Herbivore Terrain: Flier A divine being of feathers and radiant light, Seraphis is a pure spirit. Acting as a guardian over those who do good, this species lingers to bestow prophetic visions to others in their dreamscapes. It rarely touches a single feather to the ground.

game: 🎃 Creatures of Sonaria 🍬 Survive Kaiju Animals
name: Creature VESPRITTE
description: Purchase to unlock the Vespritte species, playable in-game! Tier: 2 (Small) Diet: Photovore Terrain: Flier Masters of deception, Vespritte often lie in wait, patiently disguised as blooming flowers to lure in unsuspecting invertebrates or tiny avian creatures. When the correct species is close enough, Vespritte smack them with their tails, and seems to find joy in watching a confused target flee in terror...

name: Special Operations Command
description: This gamepass gives you access to the Special Operations Command in Hamburg, which is specialized in dealing with armed criminals (Like SWAT in the US). The department includes two special armored vehicles (the BR-Titan and an Armored Truck), undercover police vehicles, special tools (A ladder and an M4 Carbine), a 30% higher shift payment, and a uniform with protective gear to stand against the most hardened criminals. Also, an exclusive sniper can be unlocked.

name: Motorcycles
description: This gamepass gives you access to motorcycles in the game. You can drive motorcycles as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer and firefighter. Motorcycles have fast acceleration and excellent maneuverability. All motorcycles also have a second seat for a companion.

name: Undercover Police
description: This gamepass gives you access to the undercover police department in Hamburg. The department includes undercover police vehicles, a 20% higher shift payment, and a special police uniform to catch criminals unnoticed!

name: Crime Boss
description: This gamepass makes you a crime boss in Hamburg. You become friends with the dealer, who will give you knuckledusters for free, a 25% discount on all items, 25% more money when selling stolen goods, and exclusive access to a sniper. You also get protective gear you can put on when you get a wanted level (in the criminal app). Also, your prison times will be 50% shorter.

name: Advanced Tuning Garage
description: This gamepass unlocks additional options for the tuning garage. You become best buddies with the mechanics, who will offer you custom vehicle and rim colors, additional engine, armor, and brake levels and special vehicle attachments. They will also provide you with a 50% discount on all vehicle repairs.

name: Electric Vehicles
description: This gamepass gives you access to electric cars, buses and trucks in the game. You can drive electric vehicles as a citizen, car mechanic, police officer, firefighter, bus driver and truck driver.
